definitions.explanation: A state of not performing well or not functioning properly. Used for people (health, athletic performance) and things (machines, business conditions).

examples.japanese: ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不調|ふちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I feel something off with my body.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧、⟦{胃腸|いちょう}→胃腸：15503_ichou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不調|ふちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: I've been having ongoing digestive problems lately.

examples.japanese: ⟦エース→エース：28537_eesu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不調|ふちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}き→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧、⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三連敗|さんれんぱい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{喫|きっ}した→喫する：29124_kissuru⟧。
examples.english: The ace's slump continued, and the team suffered three consecutive losses.

notes:
{不調|ふちょう} indicates something is not working well or someone is in poor form.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{体調|たいちょう}{不良|ふりょう}→体調不良：20233_taichoufuryou⟧/{不調|ふちょう} (poor physical condition)
- {不調|ふちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ (slump continues)
- {不調|ふちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}る→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧ (fall into a slump)
- {不調|ふちょう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{脱出|だっしゅつ}する→脱出する：26829_dasshutsusuru⟧ (come out of a slump)
- ⟦{胃腸|いちょう}→胃腸：15503_ichou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不調|ふちょう} (digestive problems)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {不調|ふちょう}: poor condition or performance (temporary state)
- ⟦{好調|こうちょう}→好調：12209_kouchou⟧: good condition, on a roll (the opposite)
